verses.english: “Mendicants, an eon contains four uncountable periods.

verses.pali: Yadā, bhikkhave, kappo saṁvaṭṭati, taṁ na sukaraṁ saṅkhātuṁ—
verses.english: When an eon contracts, it’s not easy to calculate

verses.pali: ettakāni vassānīti vā, ettakāni vassasatānīti vā, ettakāni vassasahassānīti vā, ettakāni vassasatasahassānīti vā.
verses.english: how many years, how many hundreds or thousands or hundreds of thousands of years it takes.

verses.pali: Yadā, bhikkhave, kappo saṁvaṭṭo tiṭṭhati, taṁ na sukaraṁ saṅkhātuṁ—
verses.english: When an eon remains fully contracted, it’s not easy to calculate

verses.pali: ettakāni vassānīti vā, ettakāni vassasatānīti vā, ettakāni vassasahassānīti vā, ettakāni vassasatasahassānīti vā.
verses.english: how many years, how many hundreds or thousands or hundreds of thousands of years it takes.

verses.pali: Yadā, bhikkhave, kappo vivaṭṭati, taṁ na sukaraṁ saṅkhātuṁ—
verses.english: When an eon expands, it’s not easy to calculate

verses.pali: ettakāni vassānīti vā, ettakāni vassasatānīti vā, ettakāni vassasahassānīti vā, ettakāni vassasatasahassānīti vā.
verses.english: how many years, how many hundreds or thousands or hundreds of thousands of years it takes.

verses.pali: Yadā, bhikkhave, kappo vivaṭṭo tiṭṭhati, taṁ na sukaraṁ saṅkhātuṁ—
verses.english: When an eon remains fully expanded, it’s not easy to calculate

verses.pali: ettakāni vassānīti vā, ettakāni vassasatānīti vā, ettakāni vassasahassānīti vā, ettakāni vassasatasahassānīti vā.
verses.english: how many years, how many hundreds or thousands or hundreds of thousands of years it takes.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri kappassa asaṅkhyeyyānī”ti.
verses.english: These are the four uncountable periods of an eon.”
